body.name: budgeted sequential targeting-gain modulus
body.construction: \(\Omega_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal Q)=\inf_{\mathsf D\in\mathfrak D_T(\rho;\mathcal Q)}\sup\{|\theta(P)-\theta(Q)|:P,Q\in\mathcal Q,\ \mathrm{KL}(\mathbb P_{P,\mathsf D}^{T}\Vert\mathbb P_{Q,\mathsf D}^{T})\le\kappa_\delta\}\) as an extended nonnegative real, with value \(+\infty\) when \(\mathfrak D_T(\rho;\mathcal Q)=\varnothing\).
